cards.title: How often?
cards.body: Frequency words (*jak často*) say how often you do something. Five for A1. **I always drink coffee in the morning.**
points: Use them with the present simple: **He never works on Sunday.**

cards.title: The scale
cards.body: From every time to no time.
points: **I always get up at seven.** (every time)
**I never get up at five.** (no time; *never* already says no)

cards.title: Two places
cards.body: Czech can put these words almost anywhere. English has two places.
points: Before the verb: **I often play football.** (not *I play often football*)
After *be*: **I am often tired.** (not *I often am tired*)

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: After the verb: *I drink always coffee* → **I always drink coffee**
Before *be*: *She always is late* → **She is always late**
*never* is already no. One word does it: **I never cook.**
